description: 農業廢棄物排放帳 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 資料提供包括：年別、產生量、妥善處理量、妥善處理量-就地翻耕掩埋、妥善處理量-作物栽培覆蓋、妥善處理量-倉庫墊料、妥善處理量-禽畜舍墊料、妥善處理量-育苗栽培介質、妥善處理量-飼料或飼料原料、妥善處理量-堆肥、妥善處理量-焚燒掩埋、妥善處理量-薪材燃料、妥善處理量-資源回收、妥善處理量-化製原料、妥善處理量-其他、未妥善處理量等欄位資訊，... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv, xml. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
